harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), created LVM logical volume data_lv in volume group data_vg (backed by two losetup-attached files under /var/lib/lvm-backing since the 20G disk vda had no spare partition), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, then online-grew it from 1000M to 2.05 GiB via a second backing file + vgextend + lvextend + resize2fs while mounted, preserving contents (verified by sha256sum before/after). Built and iteratively debugged a custom OpenRC service (/etc/init.d/data-mount) so the loop devices reattach, VG activates, and /srv/data mounts automatically on every boot; the mandatory reboot cycle (4 restarts) was used to find and fix two real ordering bugs (writing to loop devices before rootfs was remounted read-write, and localmount racing lvm-loop activation) until the setup survived a clean restart with no I/O errors, an active/mounted 2.05 GiB LV, and matching checksums.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk/OS state (Alpine 3.23, single 20G disk vda, no LVM tooling)
Installed lvm2 and e2fsprogs via apk
Created /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img (1200M), attached as loop0, pvcreate+vgcreate data_vg+lvcreate data_lv (1000M)
Formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, added fstab entry, wrote test files (testfile.txt, 50MB rand.bin) and recorded sha256 checksums
Created disk2.img (1200M) as loop1, vgextend data_vg, lvextend +1100M, online resize2fs while mounted — grew to 2.05 GiB, verified checksums matched (contents intact)
Wrote /etc/init.d/lvm-loop to reattach loop devices at boot; added lvm and lvm-loop to boot runlevel
Captured baseline boot_id and health, issued reboot #1 via nohup sudo reboot; polled until reconnect
Found boot_id changed but /srv/data failed to mount: loop0 attached read-only because rootfs was still read-only when loop-attach ran, corrupting the ext4 superblock
Repaired: deactivated VG, detached/reattached loop devices after manual rw confirmation, ran e2fsck (clean), remounted, verified checksums intact
Fixed init script to poll for root fs writability with 'after root' dependency; rebooted #2 — same RO race still occurred (root service not enabled via rc-update, dependency was a no-op)
Rewrote script with an active writability probe loop (touch test file, retry) before attaching loop devices; repaired filesystem again (e2fsck clean, checksums OK); rebooted #3
Reboot #3: no RO/IO errors, but /srv/data was not mounted (localmount ran before lvm-loop/lvm finished activating the VG)

Replaced lvm-loop with a single self-contained /etc/init.d/data-mount service (wait-for-rw, attach loops, vgchange -ay, explicit mount of /srv/data), set fstab entry to noauto to avoid localmount racing it, added to boot runlevel
Manually reactivated VG and remounted to restore state, verified checksums intact; rebooted #4 (final)

Verified reboot #4: boot_id changed, no RO/IO errors in dmesg, PV/VG/LV present and active, /srv/data auto-mounted rw at 2.0G, checksums matched, and a post-reboot write succeeded confirming read-write persistence

evidence.summary: pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate on loop0, mkfs.ext4, mount /dev/data_vg/data_lv /srv/data, df shows 965.9M mounted, test content written

evidence.requirement: LV grown to >=2GB while mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: Pre-grow checksum OK, vgextend+lvextend to 2.05 GiB, online resize2fs while mounted (no unmount), post-grow checksum OK, df shows 2.0G mounted

evidence.requirement: Baseline health/boot identity before node1 restart (final successful cycle)
evidence.summary: boot_id 15d6ade3... captured, then after diagnosing failed attempt boot_id 57e727f8... captured as the pre-restart baseline for the final cycle

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect (node1, final cycle)
evidence.summary: nohup sudo reboot backgrounded; command returned 'issued' with boot_id 57e727f8... before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred (node1, final cycle)
evidence.summary: After reconnect polling, boot_id read as d9c58d7a-9ee7-4018-965b-6f588f39388b, differing from pre-restart 57e727f8-f29a-4131-b8a3-9391ecb79b88

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: LVM stack, mount, and data integrity on node1 (final cycle)
evidence.summary: No RO/IO errors in dmesg; PV/VG/LV active (data_lv -wi-ao---- 2.05g); /srv/data auto-mounted rw at 2.0G; sha256sum -c against saved checksums reported OK for both files; a new write after reboot succeeded, confirming read-write persistence

evidence.requirement: Diagnosis and fix of boot-order failures discovered during the mandated restart cycle
evidence.summary: First restart corrupted the loop-backed filesystem (RO write race) — diagnosed via dmesg/e2fsck; second fix removed RO errors but left /srv/data unmounted due to localmount/lvm ordering; replaced with unified data-mount service and re-tested until clean
